credit.notes: To report a lost/stolen card, request a replacement via your Online Account or call Customer Care. Toll-free from India: 1800 419 2122 (Platinum Travel; general Card Account line). Product-specific lines: Platinum Reserve 1800 419 1030, Membership Rewards 1800 419 0167. From outside India: replace the 0 of our 0124 numbers with +91 (e.g. +91 124 670 2929). 24x7 via Mobile Messaging: Chat icon in the Amex App.
